summary: PSQ Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting the closing of its sale of the EveryLife direct-to-consumer diaper and baby products brand to FreeHold Brands, LLC. Consideration comprised $1.0 million in cash and a $4.5 million secured seller note (prime-rate interest from February 1, 2027, monthly principal of $83,333, 12-month maturity with two 12-month extensions). The note is secured by EveryLife's assets. The company retains no stated equity; the buyer is unaffiliated. The agreement dated July 28, 2025, was amended twice to modify price. Watch the buyer's bank financing and note repayment, with extension risk if refinancing fails.
